metrics: Temporal Similarity Score (DTW Distance): Measures how closely simulated relapse cycles match clinical benchmarks.
Engagement-Reward Decoupling Index: Quantifies if engagement persists even when simulated 'reward' (utility) decreases, mimicking compulsive behavior.
Parameter Sensitivity Elasticity: Measures how small changes in 'lucky-draw' or 'recommendation' parameters affect the persistence of behavior.
